Slop Recorder · free, in your browser

Record your screen with your webcam in a corner

A walkthrough reads better with your face in it. Slop Recorder draws your webcam into a corner of the screen recording while you record, with your microphone, on your own computer.

Record screen and webcam

How to do it

  1. Open Slop Recorder and choose Screen + webcam on the right.
  2. Pick the webcam's corner and size, and tick Microphone.
  3. Press Record, then pick the screen, window or tab to share. The browser asks for the camera too.
  4. After the countdown, record; Pause and Stop are at the foot of the panel.
  5. Trim the start and the end, then Download, Save to Slop Drive or Open in SlopCut.

Your files stay on this device: Slop Recorder runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Does it work on a phone?

Phones and tablets do not let web pages record the screen, so Screen + webcam needs a desktop browser. The webcam and the microphone on their own work on a phone.

Is the recording uploaded?

No. The screen and the webcam are drawn together and recorded on your computer, and the file stays there until you save it.

Can I move the webcam picture?

Choose one of the four corners and a size from 10% to 50% of the width before you record.
